actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The priest has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrip (at will): [[/item .Bnn9Nzajixvow9xi]]{light}, [[/item .n9pJzTDsAwQxJVRl]]{sacred flame}, [[/item .MUO1uYN7JR1hm4dR]]{thaumaturgy} 1st level (4 slots): [[/item .uUWb1wZgtMou0TVP]]{cure wounds}, [[/item .7buEm5KhI5lP8m1z]]{guiding bolt}, [[/item .gvdA9nPuWLck4tBl]]{sanctuary} 2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]]{lesser restoration}, [[/item .JbxsYXxSOTZbf9I0]]{spiritual weapon} 3rd level (2 slots): [[/item .15Fa6q1nH27XfbR8]]{dispel magic}, [[/item .uCud2s4TjMfjiXUb]]{spirit guardians}

actions.name: divine eminence
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra [[/damage]] damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.
